title: DE/F2: format decision for all 18 data sets — markdown+frontmatter (validated today) vs YAML (needs mdatron capability)
description: The estate's four existing artifact classes are frontmatter'd markdown validated by mdatron verify today (schemas keyed on frontmatter schema_class; **/*.md walked; wired into this repo's pre-commit via .githooks/pre-commit). YAML data files would be cleaner data semantics but are unwalked under current globs, and yaml-with-top-level-schema_class validation is an unverified mdatron capability — establishing it is a cross-repo increment owned by the mdatron session. DE recommendation: author the 18 sets as frontmatter'd markdown NOW (data in frontmatter fields, prose commentary in body — never ship governed data silently unvalidated), with carrier migration to dedicated data files recorded as an option that stays free while the sets are draft-status under the maturity lifecycle. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect. Adoption: operator (the oracle rule; also Raise-to-SO territory since it shapes every Layer 1 data deliverable).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: format ruling operator-adopted and executed — markdown-with-frontmatter for all 18 sets; the manifest re-authored in the adopted format. Evidence: commit fdbc3dc3 (mdatron verify clean at commit time), vsdd-cli #658 trail.
